chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Qāsim, from Abān, from Abī al-ʿAbbās, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Whoever puts out the eye of a beast, then one-quarter of its price is due upon him.”

key_terms.فَقَأَ: put out or ruptured, referring here to destroying the eye

ai.seo_question: What compensation is due for putting out the eye of an animal in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning injury inflicted upon an animal. It states that if someone destroys the eye of a riding or domesticated animal, he is liable for one-quarter of its monetary value as compensation.
